datasets.grain: one row per region per date

columns.region_name: string - agricultural region identifier, joins to geo.state_name
columns.date: date - observation date (past 30d) or forecast date (next 7d)

datasets.known_limitations: Live pull from the Open-Meteo Forecast API; if the API is unreachable (network-restricted sandbox) the pipeline falls back to schema-identical synthetic fixtures (src/ingestion/weather_fixture_generator.py).

datasets.refresh_frequency: static (proxy for a market-intelligence feed in this demo build)

columns.state_name: string - full state name, joins to geo.state_name and weather.region_name
columns.total_exports_musd: float - total agricultural exports, millions USD
columns.corn_musd: float - corn export value, millions USD
columns.wheat_musd: float - wheat export value, millions USD
columns.cotton_musd: float - cotton export value, millions USD
columns.dairy_musd: float - dairy export value, millions USD

columns.capital: string - state capital city, used as regional coordinate proxy
